prompt: Create one isolated illustration: One turquoise mechanical pencil, dark graphite lead projecting from its metal cone, push button and pocket clip clearly visible. Colour illustration for children, fine clean outlines and soft shaded colour fills. Use the named material colours visibly across the subject, not just its outline. Keep only the background white; naturally white parts may stay white. No monochrome sketch. Show only the requested concept, with its essential identifying details large and readable. No decorative scene, no lettering or card border.
